business_summary: YAKUODO HOLDINGS Co., Ltd., through its subsidiaries, engages in drugstore business in Japan. It retails health products, including pharmaceuticals, skin treatments, and sanitary products; beauty products comprising skincare, cosmetics, and hair and oral care products; home products, such as laundry detergents and fabric softeners; pet related products; and food products that include daily necessities, frozen food, beer, and shochu cocktails. It also involved the operation of dispensing pharmacies. YAKUODO HOLDINGS Co., Ltd. was founded in 1978 and is headquartered in Morioka, Japan.
